policy.purpose: Free or no-extra-cost cloud window candidates for routine AgentOS chat and routing.
notes: Request caps count local attempted provider calls, not provider-side billing records.
One Josh message usually maps to one API request, but retries or multi-step workflows can consume more.
Provider pricing and free-tier limits can change; keep this file conservative.

groq.free_only_guard: Use only while account is on free plan or explicitly no-extra-cost quota. Do not enable paid tools.

openrouter.free_only_guard: Use only free models or openrouter/free. Do not use paid model slugs or paid tools.

kimi_api.reason: Kimi web may be free with limits, but API free/no-extra-cost status is not verified for AgentOS automation.

cloudflare_workers_ai.reason: Workers AI has free-plan inclusion but also unit pricing; not treated as guaranteed zero-cost automation.

ollama.reason: Local models are available but Josh does not want them as the normal chat window because they are too slow.
